mods.name: Icarus Dragon
mods.author: djmad
mods.description: Rideable night dragon: place the dragon egg (workshop) and it hatches into your own dragon. Physics-based flight (Space take off/flap, Shift faster, Ctrl slower/hover, Alt descend and land, W/S pitch, A/D roll, Q/E turn), blue fireballs (left mouse), hunting vision (right mouse), animated folding wings, head follows your view, saddles and a whistle that calls the dragon. Requires UE4SS plus the IcarusDragon UE4SS folder from the GitHub release (see readme).
